summary: Add unwired iOS sidebar write dispatch and connection-owned journal lifecycle bounds.

replay.detail: Exact native action conversion preserves persisted identities and fences; ambiguous failures stay unknown delivery.

schema.detail: Version-1 journal numbers validate the Rust u32 envelope and lossless u64 snapshot indexes.

compatibility.detail: No production activation. Journal owners must close before connection replacement and callbacks honor AbortSignal. Queue limits and deadline close wedged hosts; restored state must resume before new events.

recovery.detail: Closed or timed-out hosts require a new host and durable restore; late storage completion cannot authorize old-host sends.
